one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform to build sales funnels, email marketing campaigns, and manage affiliate programs.
auth_notes: Systeme.io provides an API key generated from the dashboard settings for API access.
gate_notes: API access is available on their plans including the free tier, though endpoint rate limits or quotas may scale with paid plans.
verdict_reason: Systeme.io provides a documented REST API accessible with an API key, allowing integration for contacts, funnels, and tags.

extras.rate_limit_note: Standard rate limits apply per API account.
